events.factual_description: BODY&SOUL presents Yuya Wakai Special Quartet featuring Chris Kazuki Jones on Saturday, September 19, 2026. The announced lineup is Wakai on piano, Riku Takahashi on bass, Shun Ishiwaka on drums, and Jones on guitar. Doors are 6:30 PM, with sets at 7:30 PM and 9:00 PM. The music charge is ¥7,000 before tax / ¥7,700 tax included, and the venue currently marks reservations closed. Wakai's own September schedule and Ishiwaka's official schedule independently confirm the exact date, venue, lineup and 7:30 PM start. BODY&SOUL has separately announced September 26 as its grand finale after 52 years, placing this performance in the club's final operational week.

en.why_it_matters: The point is the quartet shape, not the names in isolation. Wakai's piano language and his ongoing rhythm-section connection with Ishiwaka are revoiced around Riku Takahashi's bass and Chris Kazuki Jones's guitar, turning a piano-trio axis into a four-way conversation with more harmonic and textural room to move. BODY&SOUL's final week adds real place-history, but the instrumental design is why the performance belongs in the first place.
en.trip_verdict: If September 19 overlaps a Tokyo stay, this is a good final-week BODY&SOUL night to catch if a cancellation opens. With reservations currently closed, I would not rearrange a wider Kanto itinerary around uncertain admission.

es.why_it_matters: La gracia está en la forma del cuarteto, no en los nombres por separado. El lenguaje pianístico de Wakai y su relación rítmica con Ishiwaka se reacomodan alrededor del bajo de Riku Takahashi y la guitarra de Chris Kazuki Jones: el eje de piano-trío se abre a una conversación de cuatro voces con más espacio armónico y de textura. Que ocurra en la última semana de BODY&SOUL añade historia del lugar, pero la razón para meterla al RADAR está primero en el diseño instrumental.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 19 de septiembre coincide con una estancia en Tokio, es una muy buena noche para alcanzar BODY&SOUL en su última semana si aparece una cancelación. Con las reservas cerradas por ahora, no reorganizaría un itinerario más amplio por Kanto alrededor de una entrada incierta.
